title: Day 9: Low-Down-Payment Paths – FHA, Conventional 3%, and Assistance Programs
body:
People searching Austin-area real estate for “FHA loans Austin”, “3 percent down homes Austin TX”, and “first time buyer assistance Texas 2026” want a local, practical answer.

Not every buyer has 20% down. Searches for FHA, low-down conventional, and down-payment assistance remain high.

These programs open doors but come with mortgage-insurance costs, property-condition standards, and sometimes income or location limits on assistance funds.

Practical reality in 2026: Well-priced homes in the mid-to-upper $300ks and low $400ks see the most activity from these buyers.

Sellers who understand the timelines and appraisal processes associated with these loans are more likely to accept them without hesitation.

Buyers should get fully underwritten pre-approval early and clarify any assistance-program stacking rules before writing offers.
